source_of_truth: early-history.git tag 0.11 for source; Linux-0.11-fork only for runtime harness

evidence.claim: pinned source is early-history.git tag 0.11 at commit b65b60f4 with tree d4303c76 and matching tarball hash
evidence.command: git rev-parse 0.11; git rev-parse 0.11^{tree}; git ls-tree -r --name-only 0.11 -- boot init | sort; sha256sum ../linux-0.11.tar.gz

evidence.claim: bootsect.s comments and constants state load addresses and BIOS setup-sector loading
evidence.command: git show 0.11:boot/bootsect.s | sha256sum; git show 0.11:boot/bootsect.s | nl -ba | sed -n '1,80p'

evidence.claim: setup.s reads BIOS data, moves system, enables A20, reloads descriptors, sets PE and jumps to absolute 0x00000
evidence.command: git show 0.11:boot/setup.s | sha256sum; git show 0.11:boot/setup.s | nl -ba | sed -n '1,80p'; git show 0.11:boot/setup.s | nl -ba | sed -n '100,200p'

evidence.claim: head.s starts 32-bit code at startup_32 and pushes main before setup_paging returns into it
evidence.command: git show 0.11:boot/head.s | sha256sum; git show 0.11:boot/head.s | nl -ba | sed -n '1,80p'; git show 0.11:boot/head.s | nl -ba | sed -n '130,145p'; git show 0.11:boot/head.s | nl -ba | sed -n '198,225p'

evidence.claim: main reads boot-time values, initializes subsystems, enables interrupts, moves to user mode and forks init
evidence.command: git show 0.11:init/main.c | sha256sum; git show 0.11:init/main.c | nl -ba | sed -n '1,100p'; git show 0.11:init/main.c | nl -ba | sed -n '104,160p'

evidence.claim: default fork build fails under GCC 16 with implicit-int and vsprintf prototype errors
fork builds successfully with gnu89 and explicit include paths under GCC 16
build produced a DOS/MBR Image and a 32-bit i386 ELF system with pinned hashes
evidence.command: ls -l Image tools/system System.map hdc-0.11.img; file Image tools/system; sha256sum Image tools/system System.map

evidence.claim: QEMU with -s -S reaches main; gdb shows breakpoint at init/main.c:107, eip=0x6771, esp in user_stack and first instructions of main
evidence.command: qemu-system-i386 -m 16M -boot a -fda Image -hda hdc-0.11.img -s -S -display none & gdb -q -batch -ex 'set debuginfod enabled off' -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'file tools/system' -ex 'target remote :1234' -ex 'break main' -ex 'continue' -ex 'bt' -ex 'info registers eip esp eax' -ex 'x/8i $eip' -ex 'info breakpoints'

open_questions: No serial console transcript was captured; QEMU was run with -display none.
Runtime uses the modernized fork at c2e45a7f; source claims remain pinned to tag 0.11 in early-history.git.
